templates.notes: Handle overlap by choosing copy direction based on pointer ranges.

visibleCases.name: non-overlapping copy
visibleCases.explanation: Baseline behavior should match memcpy when no overlap.

visibleCases.name: forward overlap
visibleCases.displayInput:
unsigned char buf[] = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8};
void *ret = memmove(buf + 2, buf, 5);
visibleCases.explanation: When destination starts inside source, copy backward.

visibleCases.name: backward overlap
visibleCases.displayInput:
unsigned char buf[] = {10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17};
void *ret = memmove(buf, buf + 3, 4);
visibleCases.explanation: When destination is before source, forward copy is safe.

visibleCases.name: zero length
visibleCases.displayInput:
unsigned char buf[] = {9, 8, 7, 6};
void *ret = memmove(buf + 1, buf, 0);
visibleCases.explanation: Boundary case; no bytes should be touched.

hiddenCases.name: large forward overlap
hiddenCases.explanation: Catches loops that copy in wrong direction.

hiddenCases.name: middle shift left
hiddenCases.explanation: Ensures pointer arithmetic is correct for sub-slices.
